name: Upload document
description: Uploads the final handover or a user-confirmed supporting file on the central CKR site. Final and legacy topic files are stored at the caller's interview-folder root; supporting files are stored in the fixed Supporting documents/ subfolder. The destination is resolved server-side from the caller's identity. Uploading with docType "final" also advances a finalized interview to Document Generated, which is what tells a later session the handover file was filed. Do NOT use this for per-topic documents: generate_topic_document produces those from the stored summary. docType "topic" is kept only for legacy recovery of a topic file that generate_topic_document cannot produce.

inputFields.label: Document type
inputFields.description: Whether this is the final interview summary, an optional supporting file, or a legacy per-topic document. Use "final" for the handover and "supporting" for a user-confirmed attachment. Do not use "topic" in the normal flow — call generate_topic_document instead; "topic" remains only for recovering a topic file the generator cannot produce.

inputFields.label: File
inputFields.description: The single user-confirmed file to upload. The final document is a generated .docx; supporting files may use their original format.

inputFields.label: File name
inputFields.description: The unique file name to store, including its extension (e.g. Topic-1 Stakeholder map.docx, InterviewFinalSummary_42.docx, or Process-Checklist.pdf). Supporting files are stored under Supporting documents/; final and legacy topic files stay at the interview-folder root.
